spread.citation: Container Recycling Institute: deposit-state redemption rates run from about 60 to 90 percent.

pricesCannabisSpendPerResidentMinor.citation: Whitney Economics, U.S. legal cannabis sales of about $30.1 billion in 2024 (reported by Ganjapreneur, January 2025); state regulator figures for 2024 summarized by the City of Los Angeles Department of Cannabis Regulation: Michigan $3.03 billion, Illinois $2.01 billion, Massachusetts $1.67 billion, Colorado $1.40 billion, California $4.66 billion.
pricesCannabisSpendPerResidentMinor.estimatedFrom: Those state sales over each state's residents (Michigan about $300, Illinois about $160, Massachusetts about $240, Colorado about $240, California about $120 a year) and the national total over the residents of the states with legal retail sales, about $170.

spread.unit: minor units per resident per year
spread.citation: Per-resident 2024 sales of California (about $120) to Michigan (about $300).

pricesCannabisUsePrevalence.citation: SAMHSA National Survey on Drug Use and Health 2023: about 22 percent of adults 18 and older used cannabis in the past year (the share among those 21 and older is close). The same national share is used for every place until a state series is loaded.
pricesCannabisUsePrevalence.estimatedFrom: NSDUH 2023 national adult past-year cannabis use, applied to every state.

spread.citation: State past-year adult use runs from the high teens to near 30 percent.

pricesCannabisAdultShare.citation: Census Bureau 2023 population estimates: about 75 percent of U.S. residents are 21 or older.
pricesCannabisAdultShare.estimatedFrom: Share of residents aged 21 and over, national.

spread.citation: State shares of residents 21 and over.

pricesChangeImpulseScale.citation: How hard a change to a household's monthly bill lands on a person's mood and stress, per share of the household's monthly earnings it moved (a bill 10% of earnings smaller lands as a mood impulse of 0.1). The same scale the benefit engine uses for a changed award (benefitChangeImpulseScale), checked against the life-event impulses the drives engine reads.

spread.unit: impulse per share of monthly earnings
spread.citation: Half to twice the benefit engine's scale.
